gates.hard_scope: The rho-to-w reference map is solved, but no BQG background dark component is currently derived.

gates.claim: Derive the physical scalar metric kernel and its stable Phi/Psi, growth, sound-speed and anisotropic-stress response from the same theory-specific physical effective action.
gates.hard_scope: No current TT, higher-shell or E/T2 finite coefficient is promoted to a dark-matter scalar response.

gates.claim: Show that the same derived Phi/Psi response predicts massive-body dynamics, weak/strong lensing and the Weyl/Fermat optical phase, with no independent lensing or interference potential.
gates.hard_scope: Reference point-lens and mu/Sigma identities are prerequisites only; observed BQG lensing closure remains uncomputed.

gates.hard_scope: Current DESI, lensing or dark-matter observations are not inputs allowed to choose the microscopic BQG output.
